name: Esli
title: Ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy
summary: Esli is a person mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus in the Gospel of Luke. He is the son of Naggai and the father of Nahum. Little is known about his life beyond his place in the lineage connecting Jesus to David and further back to Adam.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus
keyEvents.description: Esli is listed in Luke's genealogy of Jesus Christ as the son of Naggai and the father of Nahum. This places him in the Davidic lineage.

keyEvents.title: Part of the messianic lineage
keyEvents.description: As part of Jesus' genealogy, Esli is one of the links connecting Jesus to King David, thus fulfilling the messianic prophecies concerning the line of David.

keyEvents.title: The connection between David and Jesus
keyEvents.description: Esli belongs to the generations between Zerubbabel and Jesus, a period that largely coincides with the intertestamental time when God's people waited for the promised Messiah.

keyEvents.title: God's faithful plan through the generations
keyEvents.description: Esli's presence in the genealogy testifies to God's faithfulness in maintaining the messianic line through unknown and humble people over many generations.
